caption: Trip options. The change is in the '🚌 in N, M min' pair on each row: the second number is the same bus projected a full lap later, and it is now dropped when that lap would land after the route stops running. Report #89 saw 'in 25, 78 min' on Red at 6:14pm — Red's published day ends at 6pm, so the 78-min lap was never going to happen. The bus you can see (the first number) is untouched.
